m01:room.title: The Storage Survey Gallery
m01:room.job: Look at one strange dot in last night's lake trace.

m02:room.title: The Catchment Instrument House
m02:room.job: Find how fast the lake is rising right now.

m03:room.title: The Gate Calibration Bay
m03:room.job: Find how much the flow changes when the gate arm turns.

m04:room.title: The Valley Warning Office
m04:room.job: Find the latest time to close the school road.

m05:room.title: The Power Dispatch Hall
m05:room.job: Find the highest power in Unit One's old plan.

m06:room.title: The Forecast Archive
m06:room.job: Pick the storm forecast we can trust.

m07:room.title: The Water Ledger Room
m07:room.job: Add up how much water the storm will bring.

m08:room.title: The Turbine Passage
m08:room.job: Check the eight-hour plan for letting water out.

m09:room.title: The Uplift Gallery
m09:room.job: Find out if the push under the dam is really rising.

m10:room.title: The Drainage Control Room
m10:room.job: Find when the next gate step can safely go ahead.

m11:room.title: The Reservoir Survey Archive
m11:room.job: Find how much storm room the silt has taken.

m12:room.title: The Machine Hall
m12:room.job: Find how much water the surge shaft can hold.

m13:room.title: The Independent Review Gallery
m13:room.job: Price a small level error, and test the rate channel.

m14:room.title: The Emergency Communications Hall
m14:room.job: Find the fastest way to reach the dark siren.

m15:room.title: The Release Command Gallery
m15:room.job: Pick the release plan that fits every limit.
